     3	
     4	## Plan Context
     5	
     6	Refactor the GUI server and frontend code introduced by the model-settings project to improve maintainability, fix a security info-disclosure pattern, add client-side validation UX, future-proof the orchestrator's persona file discovery, and establish test coverage for previously untested GUI components. No new features — purely technical debt, security hardening, and test coverage.
     7	
     8	## Description
     9	
    10	Widen the glob pattern in `find_ledger_yaml_for_stage()` from `[1-9]-*.yaml` to `[0-9]*-*.yaml` to support two-digit persona role numbers, update the docstring, and add a test case verifying two-digit prefix matching.
    11	
    12	## Scope
    13	
    14	- `orchestrator/src/utils/persona_models.py` — `find_ledger_yaml_for_stage()` function, line 235
    15	- `orchestrator/tests/test_persona_models.py` — `TestFindLedgerYamlForStage` test class
    16	
    17	## Deliverables
    18	
    19	- Glob pattern changed from `[1-9]-*.yaml` to `[0-9]*-*.yaml` in `find_ledger_yaml_for_stage()`
    20	- Docstring warning about single-digit limitation removed or updated to reflect the new pattern
    21	- New test case in `TestFindLedgerYamlForStage` that creates a fixture file with a two-digit prefix (e.g. `10-test.yaml`) and verifies it is matched by the glob
    22	
    23	## Dependencies
    24	
    25	- None
    26	
    27	## Acceptance Criteria
    28	
    29	1. find_ledger_yaml_for_stage() glob pattern matches two-digit persona role prefixes (e.g. 10-name.yaml)
    30	2. The docstring no longer warns about a single-digit limitation
    31	3. A test case exists in TestFindLedgerYamlForStage that verifies a two-digit prefix file (e.g. 10-test.yaml) is found by the function
    32	4. The full orchestrator test suite (1,132+ tests) passes after the change
    33	
    34	## Active Pipeline Stages
    35	
    36	`implementation` → `qa` → `code-review` → `documentation`
    37	
    38	## Estimated Complexity
    39	
    40	Low
    41	
    42	## Rationale
    43	
    44	The glob `[1-9]-*.yaml` only matches single-digit prefixes (1–9). When a tenth persona role is added, its `10-*.yaml` file would be silently skipped, causing a subtle failure. `[0-9]*-*.yaml` preserves the numeric-prefix naming convention while removing the single-digit ceiling.
    45	
    46	## Rejected Approaches
    47	
    48	- *`*.yaml` (match all):* Would pick up `_shared.yaml` and other non-persona files, breaking the filtering.
    49	- *Regex filter:* Overkill — the glob pattern is sufficient and consistent with the existing approach.
    50	
    51	## Notes
    52	
    53	Independent of all other WPs. The orchestrator codebase is Python — no interaction with the TypeScript/JavaScript changes.
    54	
    55	## Code Observations
    56	
    57	Inspected `persona_models.py` (415 lines). The glob is at line 235: `for yaml_file in sorted(meta_dir.glob("[1-9]-*.yaml"))`. The docstring at lines 218–220 explicitly warns: "The glob pattern `[1-9]-*.yaml` only matches files with a **single-digit** numeric prefix (i.e. role numbers 1–9). If a tenth role is ever added with a two-digit prefix it will be silently skipped." The `TestFindLedgerYamlForStage` class in `test_persona_models.py` has existing fixtures at line 210 with single-digit prefixes.

No new features — purely technical debt, security hardening, and test coverage.
     7	
     8	## Description
     9	
    10	Extract all `mr*` state variables and functions from `config.js` into a new `config-model-registry.js` file, add client-side duplicate-slug pre-check in `mrDoSave()` and empty-name guard on inline-edit Done, and update the SPA shell HTML to load the new script.
    11	
    12	## Scope
    13	
    14	- `mcp-server/gui/public/views/config.js` — lines ~833–1395 containing all `mr*` state, helpers, and functions

    17

    20	- New file `config-model-registry.js` containing all `mr*` module-level state variables (`mrModels`, `mrOriginal`, `mrEditingId`, `MR_SLUG_REGEX`) and all `mr*` functions (`mrDeriveSlug`, `mrValidateSlug`, `mrCloneModels`, `mrHasChanges`, `mrDirtyDot`, `mrRenderRow`, `mrRenderEditRow`, `mrRefreshTab`, `mrBuildTabHtml`, `mrWireEvents`, `mrRefreshDirtyDots`, `mrValidateAddSlug`, `mrShowAddSlugError`, `mrSyncSaveButton`, `mrDoSave`, `mrDoLoadDefaults`)
    21	- Client-side duplicate-slug pre-check in `mrDoSave()`: before calling `saveModels()`, scan `mrModels` for duplicate slugs and show an inline error if found
    22	- Client-side empty-name guard in the inline-edit Done handler: reject empty name with an inline error message
    23	- Updated `index.html` with `<script src="/views/config-model-registry.js?v=1"></script>` tag before the `config.js` tag
    24	- `config.js` reduced by ~562 lines (lines 833–1395 moved out)
    25

    32	1. config-model-registry.js exists and contains all mr* state variables and functions — no mr* definitions remain in config.js

    34	3. Client-side duplicate-slug validation fires before Save in the Model Registry tab, showing an inline error without a server round-trip
    35	4. Client-side empty-name guard fires on inline-edit Done in the Model Registry tab, showing an inline error without a server round-trip
    36	5. The <script> tag for config-model-registry.js is present in index.html and loads before config.js
    37	6. Cross-tab interactions work correctly: configDirty.modelRegistry updates from mr* functions are visible to the coordinator's beforeTabSwitch() guard
    38

    40	
    41	`implementation` → `qa` → `code-review` → `documentation`

    45	Medium

    49	Per-tab file splitting mirrors the logical separation already enforced by the `mr*` prefix convention. This follows the established `project-detail-*.js` splitting pattern for large view files.
    50

    52	
    53	- *Keep monolithic config.js:* At 1395 lines with 3 tabs, the file crossed the complexity threshold during the model-settings project and is difficult to navigate.
    54	- *One file per function group:* Too granular for a vanilla-JS SPA without a module system — per-tab is the natural boundary.

    58	The new file must load BEFORE `config.js` in the SPA shell because `config.js` calls `mrWireEvents()` from `renderConfigTabContent()`. The `mr*` functions reference `configDirty` (defined in `config.js`) via the shared global scope — this cross-file dependency works because `config.js` loads after the extracted files.

All `mr*` functions are self-contained — they reference only `mr*` state, `configDirty.modelRegistry` (global), `API.saveModels` / `API.loadDefaultModels` (global), and DOM utilities (`escapeHtml`, `UI.card`, etc.). No imports from `pm*` functions. The `renderModelRegistryTab()` function on line ~833 initializes `mr*` state from server data and calls `mrBuildTabHtml()`.
